headline: Legora raised a $550 million Series E at an $8.8 billion valuation
body: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, said it raised a $550 million Series E at an $8.8 billion post-money valuation. The round was led by Atreides Management, with new investors including Fidelity Management & Research Company and J.P Morgan. The new valuation compares with $5.6 billion at the company’s previous round, and the company says ARR now stands at more than $200 million.
note: For finance people, in-house legal teams made up more than 40% of Legora’s new customers in the third quarter, a sign that buyers for agent software are widening beyond law firms.

evidence.text: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced it has raised a $550 million Series E at an $8.8 billion post-money valuation.

The round was led by Atreides Management, with participation from new investors, including Baron Capital, Capital Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Glade Brook Capital Partners, and J.P Morgan.
The new valuation compares with $5.6 billion at the company's previous round.
ARR now stands at more than $200 million.
In-house legal teams, only a small fraction of Legora's customer base a year ago, made up more than 40% of new customers in the third quarter.
